research.thesis_topic: Robust multi-agent reinforcement learning for autonomous vehicle coordination in mixed traffic environments with incomplete information

projects.name: MARL Traffic Simulator
projects.description: Built a multi-agent simulation environment in SUMO to train decentralised RL agents for intersection management. Used QMIX for cooperative reward sharing; reduced average wait time by 34% vs signal control.

projects.name: Adversarial Robustness in Autonomous Driving
projects.description: Studied impact of adversarial patch attacks on YOLO-based object detection in self-driving car pipelines. Implemented adversarial training to improve robustness by 22%.
